        var elem = document.getElementById(id);
        if (elem) {

            elem.style.display = "block";
        }
        var elem = document.getElementById(tabId);
        if (elem) {
            clearClass();
            elem.className = "current";
        }

    function clearClass() {
        for (var i = 0; i < array_tab.length; i++) {
            var elem = document.getElementById(array_tab[i]);
            if (elem)
                elem.className = "";
        }
    }


    function hideAll() {
        for (var i = 0; i < array_div.length; i++) {
            var elem = document.getElementById(array_div[i]);
            if (elem)
                elem.style.display = "none";
